name: Generate an onboarding tour skeleton for a repository without a clone
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, open Onboarding Tour from the sidebar, click 'Generate onboarding tour' and confirm the skeleton banner shows 'Clone not available.' with '0 LLM calls'. This is the one flow that writes: it stores one skeleton row in the hermetic DB and makes no LLM call, because the seeded demo repo acme/payments-api has clonePath: null (server/src/db/seed.ts). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where the demo repo is the first repo — guaranteed by the e2e-web.yml workflow's fresh seed; run locally against a clean DB (see e2e/README.md).
